question_en: How many orders are in the database in total (all statuses)?
question_id: Berapa total jumlah pesanan di database (semua status)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

question_en: How many distinct customers (real people) are in the customers table?
question_id: Berapa jumlah pelanggan unik (orang sebenarnya) di tabel customers?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers

question_en: What is the total revenue of valid orders, rounded to 2 decimals?
question_id: Berapa total pendapatan dari pesanan valid, dibulatkan 2 desimal?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

question_en: How many orders have the status 'canceled'?
question_id: Berapa banyak pesanan dengan status 'canceled'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

question_en: What is the average review score across all reviews, rounded to 2 decimals?
question_id: Berapa rata-rata skor ulasan dari semua ulasan, dibulatkan 2 desimal?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score),2) FROM order_reviews

question_en: How many orders are there per order status (all statuses)?
question_id: Berapa jumlah pesanan untuk setiap status pesanan (semua status)?
gold_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY order_status

question_en: Which are the top 5 customer states by number of distinct customers? Return state and customer count.
question_id: Sebutkan 5 negara bagian pelanggan teratas berdasarkan jumlah pelanggan unik. Tampilkan negara bagian dan jumlah pelanggannya.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY n DESC, customer_state LIMIT 5

question_en: What is the revenue per month in 2017 (valid orders), rounded to 2 decimals? Return month (YYYY-MM) and revenue.
question_id: Berapa pendapatan per bulan pada tahun 2017 (pesanan valid), dibulatkan 2 desimal? Tampilkan bulan (YYYY-MM) dan pendapatan.
gold_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp,1,7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') AND substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp,1,4) = '2017' GROUP BY 1

question_en: Which payment type has the highest total payment value among valid orders? Return the type and the total (2 decimals).
question_id: Tipe pembayaran mana yang memiliki total nilai pembayaran tertinggi pada pesanan valid? Tampilkan tipe dan totalnya (2 desimal).
gold_sql: SELECT p.payment_type, ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY p.payment_type ORDER BY SUM(p.payment_value) DESC LIMIT 1

question_en: What is the average order value (AOV) of valid orders, rounded to 2 decimals?
question_id: Berapa nilai rata-rata pesanan (AOV) dari pesanan valid, dibulatkan 2 desimal?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

question_en: What are the top 10 product categories (English names) by item sales (sum of price) in valid orders? Return category and sales (2 decimals). Only include categories that have an English name.
question_id: Apa 10 kategori produk teratas (nama Inggris) berdasarkan penjualan produk (jumlah harga) pada pesanan valid? Tampilkan kategori dan penjualannya (2 desimal). Hanya sertakan kategori yang punya nama Inggris.
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, ROUND(SUM(i.price),2) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = i.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = pr.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY SUM(i.price) DESC LIMIT 10

question_en: How many delivered orders were late (delivered after the estimated date)?
question_id: Berapa banyak pesanan yang terkirim terlambat (tiba setelah tanggal estimasi)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

question_en: Among delivered orders that have a delivery date, what percentage were late? Round to 2 decimals.
question_id: Dari pesanan berstatus delivered yang punya tanggal pengiriman, berapa persen yang terlambat? Bulatkan 2 desimal.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question_en: What is the average review score of late delivered orders, rounded to 2 decimals?
question_id: Berapa rata-rata skor ulasan untuk pesanan terkirim yang terlambat, dibulatkan 2 desimal?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.review_score),2) FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date

question_en: How many repeat customers are there (customers with 2 or more valid orders)?
question_id: Berapa banyak pelanggan yang membeli berulang (pelanggan dengan 2 pesanan valid atau lebih)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT cu.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY cu.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2)

question_en: What percentage of customers with at least one valid order are repeat customers? Round to 2 decimals.
question_id: Berapa persen pelanggan (yang punya minimal satu pesanan valid) merupakan pelanggan berulang? Bulatkan 2 desimal.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.customer_unique_id AS id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY cu.customer_unique_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM c

question_en: How many new customers did we get per month in 2017, where a customer's first valid purchase defines their month? Return month (YYYY-MM) and count.
question_id: Berapa jumlah pelanggan baru per bulan pada 2017, dengan bulan pelanggan ditentukan oleh pembelian valid pertamanya? Tampilkan bulan (YYYY-MM) dan jumlahnya.
gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT cu.customer_unique_id AS id, MIN(substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp,1,7)) AS m FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY cu.customer_unique_id) SELECT m, COUNT(*) FROM f WHERE substr(m,1,4) = '2017' GROUP BY m

question_en: Of the customers whose first valid purchase was in 2017-01, how many made a valid purchase again in 2017-02?
question_id: Dari pelanggan yang pembelian valid pertamanya pada 2017-01, berapa yang melakukan pembelian valid lagi pada 2017-02?
gold_sql: WITH v AS (SELECT cu.customer_unique_id AS id, substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp,1,7) AS m FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')), f AS (SELECT id, MIN(m) AS first_m FROM v GROUP BY id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) FROM f JOIN v ON v.id = f.id WHERE f.first_m = '2017-01' AND v.m = '2017-02'

question_en: Who are the top 3 sellers by item sales (sum of price) in valid orders? Return seller_id and sales (2 decimals).
question_id: Siapa 3 penjual teratas berdasarkan penjualan produk (jumlah harga) pada pesanan valid? Tampilkan seller_id dan penjualannya (2 desimal).
gold_sql: SELECT i.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(i.price),2) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY i.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(i.price) DESC LIMIT 3

question_en: Using whole days (compare dates, ignore time of day) relative to the latest valid purchase date in the data, how many customers have a recency of more than 180 days (their last valid purchase was more than 180 days before that date)?
question_id: Dengan hitungan hari penuh (bandingkan tanggal, abaikan jam) relatif terhadap tanggal pembelian valid terakhir di data, berapa pelanggan yang recency-nya lebih dari 180 hari (pembelian valid terakhirnya lebih dari 180 hari sebelum tanggal tersebut)?
gold_sql: WITH v AS (SELECT cu.customer_unique_id AS id, date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS d FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')), l AS (SELECT id, MAX(d) AS last_d FROM v GROUP BY id), m AS (SELECT MAX(d) AS mx FROM v) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM l, m WHERE julianday(m.mx) - julianday(l.last_d) > 180

question_en: What is the average delivery time in days for delivered orders with a delivery date (customer delivery minus purchase, using exact timestamps as fractional days)? Round to 2 decimals.
question_id: Berapa rata-rata waktu pengiriman dalam hari untuk pesanan delivered yang punya tanggal pengiriman (tanggal tiba dikurangi tanggal pembelian, memakai timestamp persis sebagai hari pecahan)? Bulatkan 2 desimal.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_purchase_timestamp)),2) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question_en: For each month from 2018-01 to 2018-06, what is the revenue (valid orders) and its month-over-month growth in percent versus the previous month (2018-01 compares with 2017-12)? Round both to 2 decimals. Return month, revenue, growth_pct.
question_id: Untuk setiap bulan dari 2018-01 sampai 2018-06, berapa pendapatan (pesanan valid) dan pertumbuhannya dalam persen dibanding bulan sebelumnya (2018-01 dibandingkan 2017-12)? Bulatkan keduanya 2 desimal. Tampilkan month, revenue, growth_pct.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT substr(o.order_purchase_timestamp,1,7) AS mo, SUM(p.payment_value) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY 1), g AS (SELECT mo, rev, LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY mo) AS prev FROM m) SELECT mo, ROUND(rev,2), ROUND(100.0*(rev-prev)/prev,2) FROM g WHERE mo BETWEEN '2018-01' AND '2018-06'

question_en: Among customer states with at least 50 reviews, which state has the lowest average review score? Return the state and the average (2 decimals).
question_id: Di antara negara bagian pelanggan yang punya minimal 50 ulasan, negara bagian mana yang rata-rata skor ulasannya paling rendah? Tampilkan negara bagian dan rata-ratanya (2 desimal).
gold_sql: SELECT cu.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score),2) FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY AVG(r.review_score) ASC LIMIT 1

question_en: What percentage of the revenue of valid orders was paid by credit_card? Round to 2 decimals.
question_id: Berapa persen pendapatan pesanan valid yang dibayar dengan credit_card? Bulatkan 2 desimal.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END)/SUM(p.payment_value),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

question_en: What is the profit margin per product category?
question_id: Berapa margin keuntungan untuk setiap kategori produk?
note: No cost data exists. A good answer says the data cannot support margins.
